requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement contains no linguistic ambiguity but exhibits concern-mixing per Pohl §25.2. It combines a functional action (administering medication) with a quality criterion (10-minute response time). Decomposed into two separate structured requirements: one functional requirement for the medication administration and one quality requirement for the alert escalation timing.

source_fragments: The nurse administers the prescribed medication to the patient.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The nurse administers the prescribed medication to the patient.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action of medication administration. Removed the conditional clause regarding response time as it belongs to the quality requirement.

source_fragments: If she does not respond within 10 minutes, the system shall escalate the alert to the duty physician.

fields.condition: the nurse does not respond within 10 minutes

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall escalate the alert to the duty physician if the nurse does not respond within 10 minutes.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality criterion (response time) and the associated action (escalation). The condition is derived from the original text's temporal constraint.
